title: PUBLIC NOTICE – IMPLEMENTATION OF THE FIM ACT
text:
13 NOVEMBER 2025
IMPLEMENTATION OF THE FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS AND MARKETS ACT, 2021 (ACT NO.
2 OF 2021)
The Namibia Financial Institutions Supervisory Authority (NAMFISA) hereby informs all Non-Bank
Financial Institutions and stakeholders that:
a) The Minister of Finance has directed NAMFISA to proceed with the implementation of the
Financial Institutions and Markets Act, 2021 (Act No. 2 of 2021) (“FIMA”).
b) The draft Regulation R.F.R.5.10 – Preservation of Retirement Benefits will NOT be
implemented together with FIMA. The regulation on preservation will be re-worked,
considering all views expressed by the public. Once the revised draft is ready, it will be
subjected to a broader public consultation process.
c) NAMFISA will communicate the commencement date and implementation modalities in due
course.
For enquiries regarding this Public Notice, please contact Mr Calvin Thembikozi at
cthembikozi@namfisa.com.na or +264 61 290 5276.
Yours sincerely,
Kenneth S. Matomola
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
